title: Mermaid trace export: the export is a deterministic flowchart TD whose first line is exactly 'flowchart TD', one node per event with zero-padded seq ids and a quote-escaped, newline-stripped, truncated label (exactly two raw double quotes per node line), one spine edge per consecutive pair (n events -> n-1 edges, 0 for the empty journal), the planned tool failure carries the fail class and replies/run_end carry say, an extension event type appended to the real journal (hook) renders through the generic path, re-renders are byte-identical, a torn tail renders the dense prefix only, the empty journal renders header + honest zero-event comment with no edges, and the CLI contract holds (0 = rendered to stdout or --out, 1 = missing journal)
